edges.mechanism: Carnitine potentiates coumarin anticoagulant effect; levocarnitine label reports INR increases with warfarin and advises INR monitoring after starting or changing carnitine dose. ALC is largely metabolized to carnitine.
edges.evidence: FDA levocarnitine label (postmarketing reports); no ALC-specific data; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Potentiation of acenocoumarol anticoagulation by L-carnitine (INR rise).
edges.evidence: Two published case reports (L-carnitine); very low certainty

edges.mechanism: L-carnitine is a peripheral antagonist of thyroid hormone action (inhibits T3/T4 nuclear entry); 2-4 g/day reversed hyperthyroid symptoms in women on suppressive L-T4. Could theoretically blunt levothyroxine effect, although an RCT in treated hypothyroid patients found improved mental fatigue.
edges.evidence: RCTs with L-carnitine and in vitro ALC data; clinical relevance at ALC doses unknown; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Carnitine antagonizes peripheral thyroid hormone action and reversed/prevented hyperthyroid symptoms in an RCT (beneficial direction).
edges.evidence: One small RCT (n=50) with L-carnitine; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Valproate causes carnitine deficiency, hyperammonemia and encephalopathy; carnitine is used to treat valproate-induced hyperammonemic encephalopathy. No evidence that carnitine provokes seizures in valproate-treated patients. Beneficial/neutral interaction.
edges.evidence: Reviews, retrospective studies, negative systematic review on seizures; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Pivalate prodrugs (e.g. cefditoren pivoxil) are excreted as pivaloylcarnitine, depleting carnitine (plasma ~45 to ~9 umol/L in 14 days); can cause hypoglycemia/encephalopathy in children. Carnitine supplementation prevented deficiency.
edges.evidence: Controlled PK study, case series (n=22), small case series; low certainty

edges.mechanism: ALC 3 g/day during adjuvant taxane chemotherapy worsened chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy at 24 weeks and over 2 years; ASCO and SIO guidelines discourage ALC for CIPN prevention.
edges.evidence: Large double-blind RCT (SWOG S0715, n=409), meta-analysis, guidelines; moderate certainty

edges.mechanism: Levocarnitine label reports seizures in patients with or without prior seizure activity and increased seizure frequency/severity in those with seizure disorders; a systematic review found no supporting literature in valproate-treated patients.
edges.evidence: Label postmarketing reports vs negative systematic review; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: High-dose oral carnitine in severe renal impairment or ESRD on dialysis may cause accumulation of TMA and TMAO.

Gut microbes convert carnitine (and ALC, ~90% of dose) to TMAO, which is pro-atherogenic in mice and associated with events in humans; supplementation raises TMAO tenfold without changing inflammatory or lipid markers over 24 weeks.
edges.evidence: Mechanistic, observational and short-term human studies; no outcome trials; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: No adequate human studies; animal studies with levocarnitine showed no fetal harm.
edges.evidence: FDA levocarnitine label; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: ALC levels fall in NRTI-associated toxic neuropathy; ALC studied as symptomatic/regenerative treatment without stopping NRTIs. Efficacy inconsistent.
edges.evidence: RCT (n=90) positive only in per-protocol analysis, open cohorts; MA negative; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Carnitines and CoQ10 are combined for idiopathic male infertility; both improve sperm parameters, without proven pregnancy benefit. Overlapping use, not proven synergy.
edges.evidence: Network meta-analyses/MAs of RCTs; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Proposed complementary glutamatergic (xc-/mGlu2), redox and mitochondrial actions; in organophosphate poisoning a mortality signal was noted with L-carnitine plus NAC.
edges.evidence: Mechanistic/narrative reviews and poisoning SR; mechanistic-inference edge; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Proposed complementary membrane-integrity (citicoline) and mitochondrial (ALC) effects for cognitive fatigue/impairment.
edges.evidence: Narrative review only; mechanistic-inference edge; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: True physiological rise in plasma TMAO with carnitine/ALC supplementation (tenfold with L-carnitine; ~50 uM after ALC).
edges.evidence: Human supplementation studies; moderate certainty for the rise itself

edges.mechanism: True INR increase in patients on coumarins (not an assay artifact).
edges.evidence: Label and case reports; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Pivaloylcarnitine from pivalate antibiotics appears as C5-acylcarnitine on tandem MS acylcarnitine analysis.
